hook: Alex Lupsasca's physics research at OpenAI is causing a stir in AI circles.
body: Recent articles highlight how Alex Lupsasca, an AI physicist at OpenAI, is challenging the company’s traditional approach to machine learning with his novel methods. His work on 'Doing Vibe Physics' suggests that AI might benefit from incorporating principles more akin to quantum mechanics and entanglement. This could revolutionize how we understand AI's behavior and potentially lead to more efficient and effective models. The implications are profound, pushing the boundaries of what AI can achieve.
